findings.title: Total pages is one too high when user count is an exact multiple of limit
findings.body: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. For example, 50 users with limit 50 reports 2 pages instead of 1. This leaves the Next button enabled on the real last page and causes a request for an empty page. Use Math.ceil(user_count / limit), while keeping the zero-count special case.

findings.title: Members endpoint accepts unbounded and negative pagination parameters
findings.body: GroupsController#members casts params[:limit] and params[:offset] to integers without validation. A limit of 0 is returned to clients and can cause division-by-zero in the Ember pagination code, negative limit/offset values can cause SQL errors, and very large limits can dump huge member lists and degrade performance. Clamp limit to a positive maximum and offset to a non-negative value.

findings.title: Public group members page can now show only the first 50 members
findings.body: The members action now always applies a default limit of 50, but the public group members template in this PR has no pagination or load-more mechanism. Previously non-automatic groups were not limited in this way. Users viewing a group with more than 50 members will see an incomplete member list unless the client is updated to paginate.

findings.title: remove_member deletes via users association with a raw user id
findings.body: remove_member calls group.users.delete(user_id), passing an integer ID to an association delete that expects User records or requires explicit removal of the corresponding group_user join record. This can raise an exception, silently fail to remove the membership, or otherwise behave unpredictably while the action may still return success. Use the model's removal method or delete the group_users row for the given user_id.

findings.title: Group creation ignores alias_level sent by the client
findings.body: The admin UI sends alias_level when creating a group and shows the alias-level control for new groups, but Admin::GroupsController#create only assigns name and visible. The selected alias level is silently lost for newly created groups. Assign alias_level in create, or hide/disable the control until the group exists.

findings.title: add_members silently ignores unknown or whitespace-padded usernames
findings.body: add_members splits the comma-separated usernames without stripping whitespace and skips any username that is not found, then returns success. Admins receive no indication that some users were not added, and input like alice, bob can fail for the spaced username. Strip each username and report or reject unknown usernames.

findings.title: Members endpoint response format changed incompatibly
findings.body: The /groups/:group_id/members.json endpoint previously returned a serialized array of members. It now returns an object with members and meta. Any external or mobile clients expecting the old array shape will break. If this endpoint is treated as a public API, provide backward compatibility or version the change.

findings.title: Group edit route does not reset pagination offset before loading members
findings.body: setupController calls model.findMembers without resetting offset. Because the Group model stores offset across navigations, returning to a group can load a previously viewed page or an empty page instead of the first page of members. Reset offset to 0 before the initial findMembers call.

findings.title: addMembers/removeMember resolve before member list is reloaded
findings.body: removeMember and addMembers call self.findMembers inside their success handlers but do not return its promise. Callers that chain the returned promise may continue before the refreshed members and user_count are available, causing stale UI state. Return self.findMembers() from the then handler.
